description: Consolidate duplicated 'Do NOT delete the marker yourself' boilerplate in the orchestrator agent doc into one shared read-only preamble, fixing the displaced implement-blocked duplicate and per-marker removal clauses.

userStories.title: Consolidate boot-marker removal boilerplate in orchestrator agent doc
userStories.description: As the orchestrator agent, I need the boot-surfaced-marker section of my instructions to state the shared 'read-only, do not delete' rule once and give each marker exactly one correct removal clause, so that the doc is unambiguous and non-contradictory.
acceptanceCriteria: In BOTH templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md and .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md, the repeated boilerplate sentence 'Do NOT delete the marker yourself. Surfacing it at boot is read-only' appears once as a shared general rule covering all boot-surfaced markers, not repeated per marker. [oracle: file-assert test "$(grep -c 'Do NOT delete the marker yourself' templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md)" -eq 1 && test "$(grep -c 'Do NOT delete the marker yourself' .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md)" -eq 1]

In BOTH files the implement-blocked block contains exactly ONE removal note stating the marker is cleared only by the next re-armed implement dispatch for that SAME issue (issueId-matched); the contradictory 'next plan run (US-004)' paragraph no longer appears under implement-blocked. [oracle: file-assert ! grep -q 'next plan run (US-004)' templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md && ! grep -q 'next plan run (US-004)' .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]

In BOTH files the plan-preflight-failed marker gains its removal-condition note (currently absent): cleared by the next plan run whose post-audit outcome is anything other than another preflight failure (issue-agnostic), per src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:1313-1320,1382. [oracle: file-assert grep -qi 'preflight' templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md]

In BOTH files the plan-escalated removal clause states that ANY converging (audit-approved -> branch-created) plan run clears it, gated on convergence not on the original issueId (the too-narrow 'for that issue' wording is dropped), per src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts:1294-1297. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The per-marker specific removal clauses (ship-stalled=merge-watch consume on PR merge; plan-escalated=convergence-gated; plan-preflight-failed=issue-agnostic non-preflight result; implement-blocked=issueId-scoped re-arm; post-merge-stalled=post-merge sequence completes; sidecar-stalled=next healthy bring-up) are each preserved and NOT collapsed into a single generic clause. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Documentation-only change: no file under src/ is modified. [oracle: file-assert test -z "$(git diff --name-only main -- src/)"]
Vendor drift check passes (bun run embed-vendor:check); run bun run embed-vendor if it flags drift. [oracle: bun run embed-vendor:check]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
Lint spine passes (bun run check:all). [oracle: bun run check:all]
